caption: The drawing depicts a single sculptural object placed centrally on a blank, beige background. The object is a small statue of a person in uniform, possibly a firefighter, standing upright and facing forward. The figure wears a brimmed hat that tilts to one side, a double-breasted jacket, a belt, and tall boots. The left arm of the figure is bent, with the hand resting on a cylindrical barrel or hydrant-like structure positioned at the figure’s left side. The barrel or hydrant has a hexagonal top and geometric and circular details on its body, suggesting valves or knobs. The statue is rendered in shades of dark brown with hints of green patina, giving it a metallic, possibly bronze-like appearance. Both the figure and the hydrant-like object rest on a rectangular base. The artist’s signature, “S. SANDER,” is visible in small writing in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Match Holder
